description: This file defines the WorkShiftDao class, which provides data access methods for handling WorkShift entities, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion operations, as well as managing employee associations with work shifts within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: WorkShiftDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for WorkShift entities, providing functions to query, save, update, and delete work shifts, as well as managing relationships with employees.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkShift entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingWorkShiftIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing work shifts from a list of provided IDs.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Returns a list of WorkShift entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftListPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for listing work shifts with applied filters and pagination.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Returns the count of work shifts matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: saveWorkShift
methods.description: Saves a new WorkShift entity and associates employees with it within a transaction.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Associates one or more employees with a specific work shift.

methods.name: updateWorkShift
methods.description: Updates an existing WorkShift and its employee associations.

methods.name: getEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Retrieves employees assigned to a specific work shift.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployees
methods.description: Removes employee associations from a work shift.

methods.name: deleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Deletes work shifts by their IDs.
